title: 31 Years Ago, The Greatest Fantasy of All Time Made History With a Major Update
content: The 1990s was a revolutionary decade for the anime industry, especially in the West, when the medium was just becoming popular. Long before streaming platforms became popular, several Japanese anime shows were made accessible worldwide on TV channels in English-dubbed formats.
author: ComicBook

title: 4 Years Later, Major Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms New U.S. Release
content: Crunchyroll returned with a brand new slate for home video releases in November this year. The platform is known across the world for streaming anime shows and films, but it also offers other services including Crunchyroll Store. Every few months or so, the platform returns with new updates and releases.
author: ComicBook

title: Oha Suta TV Show's Identity V Game-Playing Segment Gets Short Anime
content: Oha Suta Daigo Gakuen (Good Morning Studio: V Academy), the segment in the children's variety show Oha Suta in which the hosts play the Identity V video game, is inspiring a four-episode short anime that will premiere at the end of November.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling Returns With a Brand New Backstory Ahead of New Movie
content: The wait for the Solo Leveling movie continues even more than a year after the second season finale. However, the announcement took over a year, and fans will have to wait even longer for the movie to be released.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime of 2026 Is a Masterpiece That Perfects the Revenge Trope
content: Crunchyroll remains the best streaming service for the anime industry, especially this year, as it has featured waves of new and returning anime so far. However, one of the elements that always stands out is how recently released anime are embracing darker aspects more than ever before.
author: ComicBook

title: Almost 22 Years Later, Bleach Has Finally Entered Its Endgame With the Perfect Final Battle
content: Bleach has been one of the biggest anime of all time, renowned as one of the Big Three and likely to remain so for a long time. It established that identity when it was first released in October 2004, delivering the perfect combination of shonen anime elements.
author: ComicBook

title: Inukami! Novel Illustrator Kanna Wakatsuki Plans to Sue Publisher WiZH for Alleged Copyright Infringement
content: Light novel illustrator Kanna Wakatsuki wrote on August 24 in a note dated July 9 that that they are planning to sue publisher WiZH for alleged copyright infringement related to Wakatsuki and Mamisu Arizawa's Inukami! novel series. Wakatsuki claims that WiZH released a complete edition digital volume of Inukami!
author: ANN

title: Pokemon Makes History With First New Movie in 7 Years – Watch the Trailer
content: Pokémon has announced that it’s coming back with its first new movie in seven long years, and it’s going a completely different route without Ash as teased by its first look revealed with a new trailer.
author: ComicBook

title: 33 Years Later, This Unique Superhero Show Just Can’t Get a Reboot Made
content: It’s been 33 long years since Mighty Morphin Power Rangers first made its original TV broadcast debut, but it can’t seem to just get an official reboot project off the ground thanks to all sorts of shenanigans behind the scenes.
author: ComicBook

title: Sony Launches Ad-Supported Live TV on PlayStation 5 in U.S.
content: Sony announced on Monday that it is launching a free ad-supported Live TV service on PlayStation 5 in the United States on the same day. The service features over 100 live channels as well as a library of on-demand entertainment in the media section of PS5.
author: ANN
